candidates.prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on white for writing into a tag buffer a value of datatype U16. Across the TOP place exactly U16 in HUGE BOLD BLACK characters with large WHITE GAPS between each character. Capital I, if present, MUST have broad horizontal top and bottom bars, clearly different from digit 1. The exact label U16 must dominate the image and remain legible at 30x18 pixels. No other text, no shadows. Below the type show a large BLUE rectangular buffer and a bold ORANGE horizontal arrow pointing TOWARD the buffer. The arrow must clearly show data going into the buffer. Center the entire design within the square.
